name: Callable Gate: Callers
description: A callable gate that admits a caller acting for a principal listed in callers: that principal, or an agent acting for it up its chain of controllers, such as a listed user's agents. A caller it admits calls only as far as its caps, and those of the agents controlling it, cover callable/call on the callable. Give it callers as an operation default: store an operation {adapter: "callable:gates/callers", default: {callers: [...]}} and name that as the gate, by a/<hash> to keep the list fixed.

callers.description: The principals it admits, by DID, with whatever acts for each
